G4771.def:
**σύ**,
_pron._ of 2nd of person(s),
**thou, you**, genitive, σοῦ, dative, σοί, accusative, σέ, pl., ὑμεῖς, -ῶν, -ῖν, -ᾶς (enclitic in oblique cases sing., except after prep. (BL, §48, 3), though πρὸς σέ occurs in [[Mat.25.39|Mat.25:39]]). Nom. for emphasis or contrast: [[Jhn.1.30; 4.10; 5.33, 39, 44|Jhn.1:30, 4:10, 5:33, 39, 44]], [[Act.4.7|Act.4:7]], [[Eph.5.32|Eph.5:32]]; so also perhaps σὺ εἶπας, [[Mat.26.64|Mat.26:64]], al. (M, _Pr._, 86); before voc., [[Mat.2.6|Mat.2:6]], [[Luk.1.76|Luk.1:76]], [[Jhn.17.5|Jhn.17:5]], al.; sometimes without emphasis (M, _Pr._, 85f.), as also in cl., but esp. as rendering of Heb. phrase, e.g. υἱός μου εἶ σύ (בְּנִי־אַתָּה, [[Psa.2.7|Psa.2:7]]), [[Act.13.33|Act.13:33]]. The genitive (σοῦ, ὑμῶν) is sometimes placed bef. the noun: [[Luk.7.48; 12.30|Luk.7:48, 12:30]], al.; so also the enclitic σοῦ, [[Mat.9.6|Mat.9:6]] on τί ἐμοὶ κ. σοί, see: ἐγώ.
(AS)

G4750.def:
**στόμα**, -τος, τό
[in LXX chiefly for פֻּם ;]
**the mouth**: of man, [[Mat.15.11|Mat.15:11]], [[Jhn.19.29|Jhn.19:29]], [[Act.11.8|Act.11:8]], al.; of animals, [[Mat.17.27|Mat.17:27]], [[2Ti.4.17|2Ti.4:17]] (fig.), [[Heb.11.33|Heb.11:33]], [[Jas.3.3|Jas.3:3]], al.; figuratively, of inanimate things (ποταμοῦ, Hom.), ἤνοιξεν ἡ γῆ τὸ σ., [[Rev.12.16|Rev.12:16]] σ. μαχαίρας (Heb. חֶרֶב ־פֶּה, [[Gen.34.26|Gen.34:26]] al.), the edge of the sword, [[Luk.21.24|Luk.21:24]], [[Heb.11.34|Heb.11:34]]; esp. of the mouth as the organ of speech: opposite to καρδία, [[Mat.12.34|Mat.12:34]], [[Rom.10.8, 10|Rom.10:8, 10]]; in various phrases (some cl., some resembling Hebrew; cf. Bl., § 40, 9): ἀνοίγειν τ. σ. (see: ἀνοίγω); σ. πρὸς σ. (פֶּה ־אֵל פֶּה [[Num.12.8|Num.12:8]] = cl., κατὰ σ., Hdt., al.), face to face, [[2Jn.12|II Jn 12]], [[3Jn.14|3Jn.14]]; διὰ τοῦ σ. (of the Holy Spirit), [[Luk.1.70|Luk.1:70]], [[Act.1.16|Act.1:16]], al.; ἀπὸ (ἐκ) τοῦ σ. (cf. ἀπὸ σ. εἰπεῖν, Plat., al.), of speaking by word of mouth, [[Luk.22.71|Luk.22:71]], [[Act.22.14|Act.22:14]]; δόλος (ψεῦδος) ἐν τ. σ., [[1Pe.2.22|1Pe.2:22]], [[Rev.14.5|Rev.14:5]]" (LXX) ; metaphorically, ἡ ῥομφαία τοῦ σ., [[Rev.2.16|Rev.2:16]] By meton., **for speech **(Soph.): [[Mat.18.16|Mat.18:16]] (LXX), [[Luk.19.22; 21.15|Luk.19:22 21:15]], [[2Co.13.1|2Co.13:1]]
(AS)

G4762.def:
**στρέφω **
[in LXX chiefly for הָפַךְ, also for סָבַב, etc. ;]
**to turn**: with accusative of thing(s) dative of person(s), [[Mat.5.39|Mat.5:39]] = ἀποσ-, to bring back, [[Mat.27.3|Mat.27:3]] (cf. [[Isa.38.8|Isa.38:8]]); reflexively (WM, § 38, 1), to turn oneself, [[Act.7.42|Act.7:42]] with accusative before εἰς, = μετασ-, to change, [[Rev.11.6|Rev.11:6]] Pass., **reflexive, to turn oneself**: before εἰς, [[Jhn.20.14|Jhn.20:14]], [[Act.7.39; 13.46|Act.7:39 13:46]]; ptcp., στραφείς, with indic., [[Mat.7.6; 9.22; 16.23|Mat.7:6 9:22 16:23]], [[Luk.7.9; 9.55; 14.25; 22.61|Luk.7:9 9:55 14:25 22:61]], [[Jhn.1.38; 20.16|Jhn.1:38 20:16]]; id. before πρός, [[Luk.7.44; 10.22|Luk.7:44 10:22]] (WH, R, om.), [[Luk.7.23; 23.28|Luk.7:23 23:28]]; metaphorically, **to change**: absol., [[Mat.18.3|Mat.18:3]], [[Jhn.12.40|Jhn.12:40]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, δια-, ἐκ, ἐπι-, κατα-, μετα-, συ(ν)-, ὑπο-στρέφω).†
(AS)

G4728.def:
**στενός**, -ή, -όν
[in LXX for צַר, etc. ;]
**narrow**: fig (v MM, xxiii), [[Mat.7.13-14|Mat.7:13-14]], [[Luk.13.24|Luk.13:24]].†
(AS)

G4718.def:
**σταφυλή**, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX for עֵנָב ;]
**a bunch of grapes**: [[Mat.7.16|Mat.7:16]], [[Luk.6.44|Luk.6:44]], [[Rev.14.18|Rev.14:18]]. "σ. is properly the ripe grape-cluster as opposite to ὄμφαξ, cf. [[Gen.40.10|Gen.40:10]], [[Job.15.33|Job.15:33]]; as contrasted with βότρυς, it describes the grapes rather than the cluster on which they grow" (Swete, Apoc., 187 f.).†
(AS)

G4721.def:
**στέγη**, -ης, ἡ
(στέγω) [in LXX: [[Gen.8.13|Gen.8:13]] (מְכַסֶּה), etc. ;]
**a roof**: [[Mrk.2.4|Mrk.2:4]] of entering a house, εἰσέρχεσθαι ὑπὸ τὴν σ., [[Mat.8.8|Mat.8:8]], [[Luk.7.6|Luk.7:6]] (cf. MM, xxiii).†
(AS)

G4765.def:
**στρουθίον**, -ου, τό
[in LXX chiefly for צִפּוֹר ;]
dimin. of στρουθός
**a sparrow**: [[Mat.10.29, 31|Mat.10:29, 31]], [[Luk.12.6-7|Luk.12:6-7]].†
(AS)

G4716.def:
**σταυρός**, -oῦ, ὁ
1. an upright pale or stake (Hom., Hdt., Thuc., al.)
2. In late writers (Diod., Plut., al.) of the Roman instrument of crucifixion, **the Cross**: of the Cross on which Christ suffered, [[Mat.27.32, 40; 27.42|Mat.27:32, 40 27:42]], [[Mrk.15.21, 30; 15.32|Mrk.15:21, 30 15:32]], [[Luk.23.26|Luk.23:26]], [[Jhn.19.17, 19; 19.25, 31|Jhn.19:17, 19 19:25, 31]], [[Col.2.14|Col.2:14]], [[Heb.12.2|Heb.12:2]]; θάνατος σταυροῦ, [[Php.2.8|Php.2:8]] τ. αἷμα τοῦ σ., [[Col.1.20|Col.1:20]] Metaphorical, **in proverbial sayings**: αἴρειν (λαμβάνειν, βαστάζειν) τὸν σ., [[Mat.10.38; 16.24|Mat.10:38 16:24]], [[Mrk.8.34; 10.21|Mrk.8:34 10:21]], 15:21, [[Luk.9.23; 14.27|Luk.9:23 14:27]] (for an interesting ex. of metaphorically use in π., see MM, xxiii) By meton., **for Christ's death on the Cross**: [[1Co.1.17|1Co.1:17]], [[Gal.5.11; 6.12, 14|Gal.5:11 6:12, 14]], [[Eph.2.16|Eph.2:16]], [[Php.3.18|Php.3:18]]; ὁ λόγος ὁ τοῦ σ., [[1Co.1.18|1Co.1:18]]†
(AS)

G4700.def:
**σποδός**, -oῦ, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for אֵפֶר ;]
**ashes**: [[Heb.9.13|Heb.9:13]] ἐν σάκκῳ καὶ σ. ([[Isa.58.5|Isa.58:5]], [[Jhn.3.6|Jhn.3:6]], Dan LXX 9:3, al.), [[Mat.11.21|Mat.11:21]], [[Luk.10.13|Luk.10:13]].†
(AS)

G4702.def:
**σπόριμος**, -ον
(σπείρω) [in LXX: [[Gen.1.29|Gen.1:29]], [[Lev.11.37|Lev.11:37]] (זָרַע), [[Sir.40.22|Sir 40:22]] א1 * ;]
**fit for sowing, sown**; as subst., τὰ σ., **corn-fields**: [[Mat.12.1|Mat.12:1]], [[Mrk.2.23|Mrk.2:23]], [[Luk.6.1|Luk.6:1]].†
(AS)

G4719.def:
**στάχυς**, -υος, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for שִׁבֹּל ;]
**an ear of corn**: [[Mat.12.1|Mat.12:1]], [[Mrk.2.23; 4.28|Mrk.2:23 4:28]], [[Luk.6.1|Luk.6:1]].†
(AS)

G4712.def:
**στάδιον**, -ου, τό pl., στάδια ([[Jhn.6.19|Jhn.6:19]], T), and metapl., στάδιοι (see B1., 9, 1),
[in LXX: Dan LXX 4:9, [[Sus.1.37|Sus 1:37]], [[2Ma.11.5|2Ma.11:5]] [[2Mac.12.9|2Mac 12:9]] ff. * ;]
a stadium, i.e.
1. a measure of length = 600 Greek feet or 1⁄8 of a Roman mile [[Mat.14.24|Mat.14:24]] (Rec., WH, txt., R, mg.), [[Luk.24.13|Luk.24:13]], [[Jhn.6.19; 11.18|Jhn.6:19 11:18]], [[Rev.14.20; 21.16|Rev.14:20 21:16]], and, this being the length of the Olympic course,
2. **a race-course**: [[1Co.9.24|1Co.9:24]]†
(AS)

G4711.def:
**σφυρίς** (T, Rec. σπυρίς, see WH, _App._, 148; 131., § 6, 7), -ίδος, ἡ,
**a flexible mat-basket for carrying provisions**: [[Mat.15.37; 16.10|Mat.15:37 16:10]], [[Mrk.8.8, 20|Mrk.8:8, 20]] [[Act.9.25|Act.9:25]] (see: κόφινος).†
(AS)

G4768.def:
**στυγνάζω**
(στυγνός, sombre, gloomy, sullen, [[Isa.5.17|Isa.5:17]], [[Wis.17.5|Wis.17:5]], Dan LXX 2:12*), [in LXX: [[Ezk.27.35; 28.19; 32.10|Eze.27:35 28:19 32:10]] (שָׁמֵם)* ;]
**to have a sombre, gloomy appearance**: of the human countenance (RV, his countenance fell), [[Mrk.10.22|Mrk.10:22]] of the sky (so στυγνότης, Polyb., iv, 21, 1), [[Mat.16.3|Mat.16:3]] ([WH], R, mg., om.).†
(AS)

G4766.def:
**στρωννύω** or στρώννυμι
(seeBl., § 23, 1; Veitch, see word), [in LXX for יַצַע hoph., etc. ;]
**to spread**: ἱμάτια ἐν τ. ὁδῷ (εἰς τ. ὁδόν), [[Mat.21.8|Mat.21:8]], [[Mrk.11.8|Mrk.11:8]]; of making a bed, στρῶσον (sc. τ. κλίνην) σεαυτῷ, [[Act.9.34|Act.9:34]] of furnishing a room, ἐστρωμένον, spread with carpets or carpeted couches (cf. [[Ezk.23.41|Eze.23:41]]), [[Mrk.14.15|Mrk.14:15]], [[Luk.22.12|Luk.22:12]].†
(AS)

G4735.def:
**στέφανος**, -ου, ὁ
(στέφω, to encircle), [in LXX chiefly for עֲטָרָה ;]
1. that which surrounds or encompasses (as a wall, **a crowd**: Hom., al.).
2. a crown, i.e. the wreath, garland or chaplet given as a prize for victory, as a festal ornament, or as a public honour for disting­uished service or personal worth (so to sovereigns, especially on the occasion of a παρουσία, which see; cf. Deiss., _LAE_, 372 ff.; on its use in LXX for the golden crown of royalty (prop., διάδημα, which see, cf. Hort and Mayor on [[Jas.1.12|Jas.1:12]]): [[Mat.27.29|Mat.27:29]], [[Mrk.15.17|Mrk.15:17]], [[Jhn.19.2|Jhn.19:2]], 5, [[1Co.9.25|1Co.9:25]], [[Rev.4.4, 10; 6.2; 9.7; 12.1; 14.14|Rev.4:4, 10 6:2 9:7 12:1 14:14]]. Metaphorical: [[Php.4.1|Php.4:1]], [[Rev.3.11|Rev.3:11]]; τ. δικαιοσύνης (cf. Deiss., _LAE_, 312), [[2Ti.4.8|2Ti.4:8]] τ. δόξης, [[1Pe.5.4|1Pe.5:4]] καυχήσεως, [[1Th.2.19|1Th.2:19]] (see M, _Th._, in l); τ. ζωῆς (genitive appos.), [[Jas.1.12|Jas.1:12]], [[Rev.2.10|Rev.2:10]].†
(AS)

G4739.def:
**στήκω ** late Pres., formed from perf., ἕστηκα (see B1., § 17; WH, _App._, 169; Kennedy, _Sources_, 158; M, _Pr._, 238; MM, xxiii),
[in LXX: [[Exo.14.13|Exo.14:13]] A, [[Jdg.16.26|Jdg.16:26]] B, [[1Ki.8.11|3Ki.8:11]] B * ;]
**= ἵστημι, to stand**: [[Mrk.3.31; 11.25|Mrk.3:31 11:25]], [[Jhn.1.26|Jhn.1:26]], [[Rev.12.4|Rev.12:4]] (ἕστηκεν T). Metaphorical, **to stand firm, stand fast**: absol., [[Gal.5.1|Gal.5:1]] (but see Field, _Notes_, 189 f.), [[2Th.2.15|2Th.2:15]] before ἐν, [[Jhn.8.44|Jhn.8:44]] (ἕστηκεν, T, R, mg.), [[1Co.16.13|1Co.16:13]], [[Php.1.27; 4.1|Php.1:27 4:1]]; with dative, [[Rom.14.4|Rom.14:4]]†
(AS)

G4703.def:
**σπόρος**, -ου, ὁ
(σπείρω), [in LXX chiefly for זֶרַע ;]
= σπορά,
1. sowing or seedtime.
2. **seed sown **(so usually in late Gk.): [[Mrk.4.26-27|Mrk.4:26-27]], [[Luk.8.5, 11|Luk.8:5, 11]], [[2Co.9.10|2Co.9:10]] a (LTr.); metaphorically, of almsgiving, [[2Co.9.10|2Co.9:10]] b.†
(AS)

G4773.def:
**σνγγενής**, -ές (dative pl., -εῦσιν, [[Mrk.6.4|Mrk.6:4]], [[Luk.2.44|Luk.2:44]], as though from -εύς, see Swete, _Mk._, l.with; Bl., § 8, 6; cf. [[1Ma.10.89|1Ma.10:89]] A א2 *;)
(σύν, γένος), [in LXX for דּוֹד, דּוֹדָה, מִשְׁפָּחָה ;]
1. congenital, natural, innate.
2. **akin to**; as subst., **a kinsman**: [[Mrk.6.4|Mrk.6:4]], [[Luk.1.58; 2.44; 14.12; 21.16|Luk.1:58 2:44 14:12 21:16]], [[Jhn.18.26|Jhn.18:26]], [[Act.10.24|Act.10:24]]; of tribal kinship, [[Rom.9.3; 16.7, 11; 16.21|Rom.9:3 16:7, 11 16:21]].†
_SYN._: ἴδιος, οἰκεῖος (which see) (AS)

G4710.def:
**σπουδή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(σπεύδω), [in LXX chiefly for בָּהַל, its parts and derivatives ;]
1. **haste, speed**: μετὰ σ. ([[Wis.19.2|Wis.19:2]]), [[Mrk.6.25|Mrk.6:25]], [[Luk.1.39|Luk.1:39]].
2. **zeal, diligence, earnestness**: [[Rom.12.11|Rom.12:11]], [[2Co.7.11-12; 8.7-8|2Co.7:11-12 8:7-8]]; ἐν σ., [[Rom.12.8|Rom.12:8]] (see M, Pr, 104); before ὑπέρ, [[2Co.8.16|2Co.8:16]] σπουδὴν ἐνδείκνυσθαι, [[Heb.6.11|Heb.6:11]] σ. παρεισφέρειν, [[2Pe.1.5|2Pe.1:5]] πᾶσαν σ. ποιεῖσθαι, [[Jude.3|Ju 3]] (see MM, xxiii; M, _Pr._, 214; Deiss., BS, 361, 364).†
(AS)

G4727.def:
**στενάζω **
[in LXX for אָנַח ni., אָנַק, etc. ;]
**to groan **("the word denotes feeling which is internal and unexpressed," Mayor, _Ja._, 162): [[Mrk.7.34|Mrk.7:34]], [[2Co.5.2; 5.4|2Co.5:2 5:4]], [[Heb.13.17|Heb.13:17]], [[Jas.5.9|Jas.5:9]] (EV, murmur); ἐν ἑαυτοῖς, [[Rom.8.23|Rom.8:23]] (cf. ἀνα-, συ(ν)-στενάζω).†
_SYN._: see: κλαίω (AS)

G4746.def:
**στοιβάς**, see: στιβάς.
**στιβάς**, -άδος, ἡ,
[in Aq.: [[Ezk.46.23|Eze.46:23]] (טִירוֺת) * ;]
**a litter of leaves or rushes**: pl., [[Mrk.11.8|Mrk.11:8]] (Rec. στοιβ-).†
(AS)

G4749.def:
**στολή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(στέλλω), [in LXX chiefly for בֶּגֶד, also for לְבוּשׁ, etc. ;]
1 1, an equipment, an armament (Æsch.).
2. Equipment in clothes, apparel, esp. flowing raiment, **a festal robe**: (cf. [[Jon.3.6|Jon.3:6]], [[Est.8.15|Est.8:15]], [[1Ma.6.15|1Ma.6:15]]): [[Mrk.12.38; 16.5|Mrk.12:38 16:5]], [[Luk.15.22; 20.46|Luk.15:22 20:46]], [[Rev.6.11; 7.9, 13-14; 22.14|Rev.6:11 7:9, 13-14 22:14]].†
(AS)

G4775.def:
**συν-κάθημαι**
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: [[Psa.101.6|Psa.101:6]] (יָשַׁב) * ;]
**to sit together or with**: with dative, [[Act.26.30|Act.26:30]] before μετά, with genitive, [[Mrk.14.54|Mrk.14:54]]†
(AS)

G4714.def:
**στάσις**, -εως, ἡ
(ἵστημι), [in LXX chiefly for עָמַד, its parts and derivatives, also for רִיב (Pr 1714), etc. (see Deiss., BS, 158 f.) ;]
1. **a standing, place, status**: σ. ἔχειν (Polyb., v, 5, 3; and cf. Lat. locum habere), [[Heb.9.8|Heb.9:8]]
2. **insurrection, sedition**: [[Mrk.15.7|Mrk.15:7]], [[Luk.23.19, 25|Luk.23:19, 25]], [[Act.19.40; 24.5|Act.19:40 24:5]].
3. In poets and late prose, strife, dissension (cf. MM, xxiii) [[Act.15.2; 23.7, 10|Act.15:2 23:7, 10]].†
(AS)

G4779.def:
**συν-καλέω**
(Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ, [in LXX for קָרָא ;]
**to call together**: with accusative, [[Mrk.15.16|Mrk.15:16]], [[Luk.15.6|Luk.15:6]], 9 (seel. -εῖται, see B1., § 55, 1), [[Act.5.21|Act.5:21]] Mid., **to call together to oneself**: [[Luk.9.1|Luk.9:1]] (and seel. in [[Luk.15.6|Luk.15:6]], 9 see supr.) [[Luk.23.13|Luk.23:13]], [[Act.10.24; 28.17|Act.10:24 28:17]].†
(AS)

G4723.def:
**στεῖρος**, -ον also -α, -ον,
[in LXX for עָקָר ;]
**barren**: of a woman, [[Luk.1.7, 36; 23.29|Luk.1:7, 36 23:29]], [[Gal.4.27|Gal.4:27]]" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G4796.def:
**συν-χαίρω**
(Rec. συγ-), [in LXX: [[Gen.21.6|Gen.21:6]] (צָחַק), [[3Ma.1.8|3Ma.1:8]] R * ;]
1. **to rejoice with**: with dative of person(s), [[Luk.1.58; 15.6, 9|Luk.1:58 15:6, 9]], [[Php.2.17-18|Php.2:17-18]], EV; with dative of thing(s), [[1Co.12.26; 13.6|1Co.12:26 13:6]].
2. **to congratulate **(Æschin., Polyb., al.): Phi, l.with (Lft., in I.; cf. MM, xxiv).†
(AS)

G4772.def:
**συγγένεια**, -ας, ἡ
(συγγενής), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁפָּחָה ;]
1. kinship.
2. By meton., **kinsfolk, kindred**: [[Luk.1.61|Luk.1:61]], [[Act.7.3, 14|Act.7:3, 14]] †
(AS)

G4756.def:
**στρατιά**, -ᾶς, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for צָבָא ;]
1. **= στρατός, an army, a host**: of angels ([[3Ki.22.19|3Ki.22:19]], al.), [[Luk.2.13|Luk.2:13]]; of the stars of heaven ([[Jer.8.2|Jer.8:2]], [[2Ch.33.3|2Ch.33:3]]), [[Act.7.42|Act.7:42]].
2. As sometimes in cl. (poët.), = στρατεία: [[2Co.10.4|2Co.10:4]], T (WH, RV, στρατεία).†
(AS)

G4754.def:
**στρατεύω ** and depon., -ομαι, so always in NT
(στρατός, an encamped army), [in LXX for מההּ hith., יָצָא, צָבָא; metaphorically, [[4Ma.9.23|4Ma.9:23]] ;]
used of the general, to make war, do battle, and (chiefly) of the soldiers serving under him, **to serve as a soldier**: [[Luk.3.14|Luk.3:14]], [[1Co.9.7|1Co.9:7]], [[2Ti.2.4|2Ti.2:4]]. Metaphorical (cf. MM, ii, xxiii), of spiritual conflict, **to war, make war**: [[2Co.10.3|2Co.10:3]], [[1Ti.1.18|1Ti.1:18]], [[Jas.4.1|Jas.4:1]], [[1Pe.2.11|1Pe.2:11]].†
(AS)

G4743.def:
**στιγμή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(στίζω, to prick), [in LXX: [[Isa.29.5|Isa.29:5]] (פֶּתַע), [[2Ma.9.11|2Ma.9:11]] * ;]
**a prick, a point**; metaphorically, σ. χρόνου, **a moment**: [[Luk.4.5|Luk.4:5]]†
(AS)

G4788.def:
**συν-κλείω**
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX chiefly for סגר ;]
**to shut together, enclose, shut in on all sides**: of a catch of fish, [[Luk.5.6|Luk.5:6]] metaphorically ([[Psa.31.9|Psa.31:9]], al.), [[Rom.11.32|Rom.11:32]], [[Gal.3.22-23|Gal.3:22-23]].†
(AS)

G4709.def:
**σπουδαίως**
_ adv._ (σπουδαῖος), [in LXX: [[Wis.2.6|Wis.2:6]] * ;]
1. with haste or zeal, i.e. earnestly, **zealously, diligently**: [[Luk.7.4|Luk.7:4]], [[2Ti.1.17|2Ti.1:17]], [[Tit.3.13|Tit.3:13]]; compar., -οτέρως, [[Php.2.28|Php.2:28]] (RV, Lft., Weymouth, al., but see infr.)
2. **hastily, speedily**: compar., -οτέρως, [[Php.2.28|Php.2:28]] (Thayer, Zorell, see word; _ICC_, in l, al., but see supr.).†
(AS)

G4795.def:
**συγκυρία**, -ας, ἡ
(συγκυρέω, to happen), [in Sm.: [[1Sa.6.9|1Ki.6:9]] (מִקְרֶה) * ;] (more frequently in late writers, συγκύρησις, -ημα),
**chance, coincidence**: κατὰ σ. (see MM, xxiii), [[Luk.10.31|Luk.10:31]] (Hippocr., Eccl.).†
(AS)

G4780.def:
**συν-καλύπτω**
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX chiefly for כָּסָה pi. ;]
**to veil or cover completely**: with accusative, pass., [[Luk.12.2|Luk.12:2]]†
(AS)

G4794.def:
**συν-κύπτω**
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: [[Job.9.27|Job.9:27]] (עָזַב), [[Sir.12.11; 19.26|Sir.12:11 19:26]] * ;]
1. to bend forwards (Arist., al.).
2. **to be bowed down**: [[Luk.13.11|Luk.13:11]]†
(AS)

G4760.def:
**στρατό-πεδον**, -ου, τό
(στρατός + πέδον, a plain), [in LXX: [[Jer.34.1|Jer.34:1]] (חַיִל), [[2Ma.8.12|2Ma.8:12]], al. ;]
(a) **a military camp**;
(b) **an army**: [[Luk.21.20|Luk.21:20]]†
(AS)

G4755.def:
**στρατηγός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(στραός, ἄγω), [in LXX chiefly for סָגָן (always in pl.), שַׂר ;]
1. a military commander, a general (Hdt., al.).
2. **A civic commander, a governor, magistrate **(Hdt., Xen., al.): [[Act.16.20, 22; 16.35-36, 38|Act.16:20, 22 16:35-36, 38]].
3. The commander of the Levitical guard of the Temple, ὁ σ. τ. ἱεροῦ (EV, captain of the Temple): [[Act.4.1; 5.24, 26|Act.4:1 5:24, 26]]; pl., [[Luk.22.4, 52|Luk.22:4, 52]].†
_SYN._: ἄρχων (cf. EGT on [[Act.16.20|Act.16:20]] Ramsay, St. Paul, 217). (AS)

G4776.def:
**περι-καθ-ίζω **
[in LXX for חָנָה, לָחַם ni., etc. ;]
1. **to invest, besiege** (Diod., [[4Ki.6.24|4Ki.6:24]], [[1Ma.11.61|1Ma.11:61]], al.).
2. **to sit around**: [[Luk.22.55|Luk.22:55]], L, txt.
† (AS)

G4784.def:
**συν-κατα-τίθημι**
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: [[Exo.23.1|Exo.23:1]] (שִׁית יָד), [[Exo.23.32|Exo.23:32]] (בְּרִית), Da TH [[Sus.1.20|Su 1:20]] * ;]
to deposit together. Mid., **to deposit one's vote with, hence, to agree with, assent to**: with dative, [[Luk.23.51|Luk.23:51]]†
(AS)

G4798.def:
**συν-χράομαι**
(Rec. συγ-), -ῶμαι, [in Al.: [[1Sa.30.19|1Ki.30:19]] * ;]
to use together with. Metaphorical, with dative of person(s), **to associate with**: [[Jhn.4.9|Jhn.4:9]] (Polyb., a1.).†
(AS)

G4745.def:
**στοά**, -ᾶς, ἡ
[in LXX: [[Ezk.40.18|Eze.40:18]] (רִצְפָּה), etc. ;]
**a portico**: [[Jhn.5.2|Jhn.5:2]] used of the covered colonnade in the Temple (EV, porch), [[Jhn.10.23|Jhn.10:23]] [[Act.3.11; 5.12|Act.3:11 5:12]] †
(AS)

G4785.def:
**συν-κατα-ψηφίζω** (Rec. συγκ-),
1. to condemn with or together (Plut., Themist., 21).
2. **to vote one a place among**: pass., [[Act.1.26|Act.1:26]] Not elsewhere .†
(AS)

G4797.def:
**συν-χέω**
(Rec. συγ-), [in LXX for בָּלַל, רָגַז, etc. ;]
**to pour together, commingle, confuse**; metaphorically, **confound, throw into confusion, stir up trouble**: [[Act.21.27|Act.21:27]] (cf. συν-χύννω).†
(AS)

G4732.def:
**στερεόω**, -ῶ
(στερεός), [in LXX: [[Isa.42.5|Isa.42:5]] (רָקַע), [[Jer.5.3|Jer.5:3]] (חָזַק pi.), etc. ;]
(a) **to make firm or solid**;
(b) **to strengthen, make strong**; with accusative of person(s), [[Act.3.16|Act.3:16]] τ. βάσεις, pass., [[Act.3.7|Act.3:7]] Metaphorical (cf. Je, l.with): τ. πίστει, pass., [[Act.16.5|Act.16:5]]†
(AS)

G4787.def:
**συν-κινέω** (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ,
to move together. Metaphorical, **to excite, stir up**: τ. λαόν, [[Act.6.12|Act.6:12]] (Arist., Polyb., al.).†
(AS)

G4726.def:
**στεναγμός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(στενάζω), [in LXX for אֲנָחָה, אֲנָקָה, נְאָקָה, etc. ;]
**a groaning**: [[Act.7.34|Act.7:34]] (LXX κραυγή), [[Rom.8.26|Rom.8:26]]†
(AS)

G4792.def:
**συν-κομίζω**
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: [[Job.5.26|Job.5:26]] (עָלָה) * ;]
1. to bring together, collect (Hdt., Xen., al.).
2. **to take up a body for burial **(Soph., Aj., 1048): [[Act.8.2|Act.8:2]] (see Field, _Notes_, 116).†
(AS)

G4725.def:
**στέμμα**, -τος, τό
(στέφω, to put around, enwreath)
**a wreath, garland**: as used in sacrifices, [[Act.14.13|Act.14:13]]†
(AS)

G4799.def:
**σύγχυσις**, -εως, ἡ
(συγχέω), [in LXX: [[Gen.11.9|Gen.11:9]] (בָּבֶל), [[1Ki.5.6; 5.12|1Ki.5:6 5:12]](11) [[1Sa.14.20|1Ki.14:20]] (מְהוּמָה) * ;]
**confusion**: of a popular uproar, [[Act.19.29|Act.19:29]]†
(AS)

G4748.def:
**στοιχέω**, -ῶ
(στοῖχος, a row), [in LXX: [[Ecc.11.6|Ecc.11:6]] (כָּשֵׁר) * ;]
to be in rows (of waves, plants, etc., as well as of men), to walk in line (esp. of marching in file to battle; Xen., Cyr., vi, 3, 34, al.). Metaphorical, **in late writers, to walk by rule**: [[Act.21.24|Act.21:24]] with dative, to walk by or in (as a rule of life), [[Rom.4.12|Rom.4:12]] (cf. MM, xxiii), [[Gal.5.25; 6.16|Gal.5:25 6:16]], [[Php.3.16|Php.3:16]] (cf. συν-στοιχέω).†
(AS)

G4782.def:
**συν-κατα-βαίνω**
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: [[Psa.49.17|Psa.49:17]] (יָרַד), [[Wis.10.13|Wis.10:13]], [[Dan.3.49|Dan LXX TH 3:49]] * ;]
**to go down with**: [[Act.25.5|Act.25:5]] In late writers also metaphorically (Wis, l.with), to condescend, on WH. see Rutherford, _NPhr._, 485 f.†
(AS)

G4730.def:
**στενοχωρία**, -ας, ἡ (see supr.)
[in LXX for צוֹק, etc. ;]
narrowness of space, want of room (Thuc., al.). Metaphorical (Ken., Polyb., [[Deu.28.53|Deu.28:53]], [[Wis.5.3|Wis.5:3]], al.), **difficulty, distress**: θλίψις καὶ (ἢ) σ., [[Rom.2.9; 8.35|Rom.2:9 8:35]] (EV, anguish); pl. (cf. Bl., § 32, 6; WM, 220), [[2Co.6.4; 12.10|2Co.6:4 12:10]].†
_SYN._: θλίψις, q.v (AS)

G4789.def:
**συν-κληρο-νόμος** (Rec. συγκ-), -ου, ὁ
**a co-inheritor, fellow-heir**: [[Rom.8.17|Rom.8:17]], [[Eph.3.6|Eph.3:6]]; with genitive of thing(s), [[Heb.11.9|Heb.11:9]], [[1Pe.3.7|1Pe.3:7]] (for exx., see Deiss., _LAE_, 88 f.).†
(AS)

G4781.def:
**συν-κάμπτω**
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: [[Psa.68.10, 23|Psa.68:10, 23]] (מעד hi.), etc. ;]
**to bend completely, bend together**: τ. νῶτον, figuratively, [[Rom.11.10|Rom.11:10]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G4791.def:
**συν-κοινωνός** (Rec. συγκ-), όν,
**partaking jointly of**: with genitive of thing(s), [[Rom.11.17|Rom.11:17]], [[1Co.9.23|1Co.9:23]]; id. with genitive of person(s), [[Php.1.7|Php.1:7]] before ἐν, [[Rev.1.9|Rev.1:9]]†
(AS)

G4793.def:
**συν-κρίνω (Rec. συγκ-) **
[in LXX chiefly for פָּתַר ;]
1. **to compound, combine**: [[1Co.2.13|1Co.2:13]], R, mg.1 (Lft., _Notes_, 180 f.).
2. In Arist. and later writers ([[Wis.7.29|Wis.7:29]], a1.) = παραβάλλω, **to compare**: 1Co, l.with, R, txt. (Field, _Notes_, 168), [[2Co.10.12|2Co.10:12]]
3. In LXX, of dreams, to interpret ([[Gen.40.8|Gen.40:8]], 1Co, l.with, R, mg. 2 (but see reff. supr.).†
(AS)

G4774.def:
**συν-γνώμη (Rec. συγγ-), -ης, ἡ**
(συγγιγνώσκω, (a) to agree with; (b) to pardon), [in LXX: Sir prol.14 (B1N1 cm.) 313, [[2Mac.14.20|2Mac 14:20]]* ;]
1. confession.
2. **fellow feeling; hence, concession, allowance**: [[1Co.7.6|1Co.7:6]] (see _ICC_, in l).
3. pardon.†
(AS)

G4722.def:
**στέγω**
(cf. Lat. tego), [in LXX: [[Sir.8.17|Sir.8:17]] * ;]
1. prop., to cover closely, to protect by covering, esp. to keep water in or out (Soph., Plat., al.).
2. **to cover, keep secret, conceal **(Sir, l.with, Polyb., al.): [[1Co.13.7|1Co.13:7]], R, mg.
3. **By covering to ward of, bear up under, endure **(for exx., see, Lft., _Notes_, 40; M, _Th._, 36): [[1Co.9.12; 13.7|1Co.9:12 13:7]], [[1Th.3.1; 3.5|1Th.3:1 3:5]].†
(AS)

G4786.def:
**συν-κεράννυμι**
(Rec. συγκ-), [in LXX: Dan LXX 2:43 (עֲרַב ithpa.), [[2Ma.15.39|2Ma.15:39]] * ;]
**to mix or blend together, compound**: with accusative, [[1Co.12.24|1Co.12:24]] ptcp. pf. pass., [[Heb.4.2|Heb.4:2]], T, WH, mg., R, mg.; id., of persons, with dative instr., to be united with, agree with, ib., WH, txt., R, txt. (see Westc., in l).†
(AS)

G4729.def:
**στενο-χωρέω**, -ῶ
(στενός + χῶρος, space) [in LXX: [[Jos.17.15|Jos.17:15]] (אוּץ), [[Jdg.16.16|Jdg.16:16]] (אָלַץ pi.), [[Isa.28.19|Isa.28:19]] (20) (קָצַר) [[Isa.49.19|Isa.49:19]] (צָרַר), [[4Ma.11.11|4Ma.11:11]] * ;]
1. to be straitened (cf. [[Isa.49.19|Isa.49:19]]); metaphorically, to be anxious (Hipp., al.).
2. In late writers, trans., **to straiten, compress **(LXX, Diod., al.; π. ap. MM, xxiii): pass., trop., [[2Co.4.8; 6.12|2Co.4:8 6:12]].†
(AS)

G4705.def:
**σπουδαῖος**, -α, -ον
(σπουδή), [in LXX: [[Ezk.41.25|Eze.41:25]] * ;]
**in haste; hence, zealous, eager, diligent, earnest**: before ἐν, [[2Co.8.22|2Co.8:22]] compar., -οτεροσς [[2Co.8.17|2Co.8:17]] (here in superl. sense, see Bl., § 44, 3) [[2Co.8.22|2Co.8:22]]†
(AS)

G4724.def:
**στέλλω **
[in LXX (mid.): [[Mal.2.5|Mal.2:5]] (חָתַת ni.), [[Pro.31.24|Pro.31:24]] (26), [[Wis.7.14; 14.1|Wis.7:14 14:1]], [[2Ma.5.1|2Ma.5:1]], [[3Ma.1.19|3Ma.1:19]] [[3Mac.4.11|3Mac 4:11]] * ;]
1. prop., to set, place, arrange, fit out; hence, mid., to set oneself for, prepare (Wis, xi Mac, ll. with).
2. to bring together, gather up (in Hom. of furling sails), hence to restrain, check; mid., **to restrain or withdraw oneself, hold aloof, avoid**: [[2Co.8.20|2Co.8:20]] before ἀπό, [[2Th.3.6|2Th.3:6]]
(cf. ἀπο-, ἐξ-απο-, συν-απο-, δια-, ἐπι-, κατα-, συ(ν)-, ὑπο-στέλλω).†
(AS)

G4752.def:
**στρατεία** (on the orthogr., see Deiss., BS, 181 f.), -ας, ἡ
(οτρατεύω), [in LXX chiefly for צָבָא ;]
**an expedition, a campaign, warfare**: metaphorically, [[2Co.10.4|2Co.10:4]] (-τιά, T), [[1Ti.1.18|1Ti.1:18]]†
(AS)

G4769.def:
**στύλος (T**, στῦλος, as in cl.), -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for עַמּוּד, also for קֶרֶשׁ, etc. ;]
**a pillar, regarded especially as a support**: σ. πυρός, [[Rev.10.1|Rev.10:1]] σ. ἐν τ. ναῷ, figuratively, [[Rev.3.12|Rev.3:12]], Metaphorical, [[Gal.2.9|Gal.2:9]] τ. ἀληθείας, [[1Ti.3.15|1Ti.3:15]]†
(AS)

G4704.def:
**σπουδάζω**
(σπουδή), [in LXX chiefly for בָּהַל ;]
**to make haste; hence, to be zealous or eager, to give diligence**: with inf. (see M, _Pr._, 205 f.), [[Gal.2.10|Gal.2:10]], [[Eph.4.3|Eph.4:3]], [[1Th.2.17|1Th.2:17]], [[2Ti.2.15; 4.9; 4.21|2Ti.2:15 4:9 4:21]], [[Tit.3.12|Tit.3:12]], [[Heb.4.11|Heb.4:11]], [[2Pe.1.10; 3.14|2Pe.1:10 3:14]]; with accusative and inf. (on this construction see Mayor in l; MM, xxiii), [[2Pe.1.15|2Pe.1:15]] (for other constructions see LS, see word).†
(AS)

G4747.def:
**στοιχεῖον**, -ου, τό
[in LXX: [[Wis.7.17; 19.18|Wis.7:17 19:18]], [[4Ma.12.13|4Ma.12:13]] * ;]
prop., one of a row (στοῖχος) or series, hence,
1. the shadow-line of a dial (Aristoph.).
2. an elementary sound or letter of the alphabet (Anth., Plut., π.).
3. the elements or rudiments of knowledge (Arist., al.) [[Heb.5.12|Heb.5:12]] πτωχὰ σ., [[Gal.4.9|Gal.4:9]] σ. τοῦ κόσμου, [[Gal.4.3|Gal.4:3]], [[Col.2.8, 20|Col.2:8, 20]] (but see infr.).
4. **The material elements of the universe **(Plat.; LXX, ll. with): [[2Pe.3.10; 3.12|2Pe.3:10 3:12]].
5. The heavenly bodies (Ding. Laert.).
6. The demons or tutelary spirits of nature (Enoch., Test., Sol., al.; for this sense in Ga, Col, ll. with, see _ICC_ on [[Col.2.8|Col.2:8]] Enc. Bibl., see word " Elements ").†
(AS)

G4742.def:
**στίγμα -τος**, τό
(στίζω, to prick), [in LXX: [[Sng.1.11|Sng.1:11]] (נְקֻדָּה) * ;]
**a tattoed mark or brand**: τὰ σ. τοῦ Ἰησοῦ, [[Gal.6.17|Gal.6:17]] (see Lft., in l; Deiss., BS, 349; _LAE_, 303; MM, xxiii).†
(AS)

G4790.def:
**συν-κοινωνέω** (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ,
**to have fellowship with or in **(in cl., with genitive of thing(s), dative of person(s)): with dative of thing(s), [[Eph.5.11|Eph.5:11]], [[Rev.18.4|Rev.18:4]]; id. with genitive of person(s), [[Php.4.14|Php.4:14]]†
(AS)

G4708.def:
earnestly, zealously, with vigor; (compar.) all the more eager, with special urgency eagerly
**earnestly, eagerly, diligently,** [[Luk.7.4|Lk. 7:4]]; [[2Ti.1.17|2Tim. 1:17]] [[Tit.3.13|Tit. 3:13]] _comparative_ σπουδαιοτέρως, **more earnestly, with special urgency,** [[Php.2.28|Phil. 2:28]]

G4733.def:
**στερέωμα**, -τος, τό
(στερεόω), [in LXX: [[Gen.1.6|Gen.1:6]] ff., [[Psa.19.1; 150.1|Psa.19:1 150:1]], [[Ezk.1.22-26; 10.1; 13.5|Eze.1:22-26 10:1 13:5]], Dan LXX, TH [[Dan.3.56|Dan.3:56]], [[Dan.12.3|Dan.12:3]] (רָקִיעַ), [[Deu.33.26|Deu.33:26]] (שַׁחַק), [[Psa.18.2; 71.3|Psa.18:2 71:3]] (סֶלַע), [[Est.9.29|Est.9:29]], I [[Est.8.78|Est.8:78]] (82), [[Sir.43.1|Sir.43:1]], 8, [[1Ma.9.14|1Ma.9:14]] * ;]
**a solid body**;
(a) **a support, foundation **(Arist., al.); metaphorically, strength ([[Psa.17.1-15; 70.1-5|Psa.17:1-15 70:1-5]], 1Mac, ll. with); steadfastness, **firmness**: τ. πίστεως, [[Col.2.5|Col.2:5]]
(b) the dome of heaven (believed to be a solid canopy), the firmament (LXX).†
(AS)

G4777.def:
**συν-κακοπαθέω** (Rec. συγκ-), -ῶ,
**to bear evil treatment along with, take one's share of ill-treatment**: [[2Ti.2.3|2Ti.2:3]] with dative commod., τ. εὐαγγελίῳ, [[2Ti.2.18|2Ti.2:18]]†
(AS)

G4758.def:
**στρατολογέω**, -ῶ
(στρατός, λέγω),
**to levy a troop, enlist soldiers**: [[2Ti.2.4|2Ti.2:4]] (Diod., Plut., al.).†
(AS)

G4737.def:
**στεφανόω**, -ῶ
(στέφανος), [in LXX for עָטַר ;]
with accusative of person(s),
**to crown**: of a victor, [[2Ti.2.5|2Ti.2:5]] Metaphorical, δόξῃ κ. τιμῇ, [[Heb.2.7|Heb.2:7]], 9" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G4731.def:
**στερεός**, -ά, -όν
[in LXX: [[Num.8.4|Num.8:4]] (מִקְשָׁה); σ. πέτρα, [[Isa.5.28|Isa.5:28]] (צַר), etc. ;]
**hard, firm, solid**: τροψή, [[Heb.5.12, 14|Heb.5:12, 14]]; θεμέλιος, figuratively, [[2Ti.2.19|2Ti.2:19]] Metaphorical,
(a) **in bad sense, hard, cruel **(Hom., al.);
(b) **in good sense, steadfast, firm**: τ. πίστει, [[1Pe.5.9|1Pe.5:9]]†
(AS)

G4713.def:
**στάρνος**, -ου (ὁ and), ἡ
[in LXX: [[Exo.16.33|Exo.16:33]] (צִנְצֶנֶת), [[3Ki.12.24 14:3|3Ki.12:24 14:3]] (בַּקְבֻּק), Dan LXX Bel, 1:32 * ;]
prop., an earthen jar for racking off wine, hence, generally, **a jar**: [[Heb.9.4|Heb.9:4]]†
(AS)

G4778.def:
**συν-κακουχέομαι** (Rec. συγκ-), -οῦμαι, pass.
**to endure adversity with**: with dative of person(s), [[Heb.11.25|Heb.11:25]] Not elsewhere.†
(AS)

G4701.def:
**σπορά**, -ᾶς, ἡ
(σπείρω), [in LXX: [[2Ki.19.29|4Ki.19:29]] (זָרַע), [[1Ma.10.30|1Ma.10:30]] * ;]
1. a sowing.
2. seedtime.
3. **seed sown **(of human offspring, Soph., Tr., 316, 420): [[1Pe.1.23|1Pe.1:23]]
(cf. σπέρμα, and see Milligan, _NTD_, 105 f.).†
(AS)

G4761.def:
**στρεβλόω**, -ῶ
(στρέφω), [in LXX: [[2Sa.22.27|2Ki.22:27]] (פָּתַל hithp.), [[3Ma.4.14|3Ma.4:14]], [[4Ma.9.17|4Ma.9:17]] [[4Mac.12.4|4Mac 12:4]] [[4Mac.12.11|4Mac 12:11]] [[4Mac.15.14|4Mac 15:14]] * ;]
to twist, torture. Metaphorical (cf. 2Ki, l.with), **to twist or pervert language**: [[2Pe.3.16|2Pe.3:16]]†
(AS)

G4740.def:
**στηριγμός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(στηρίζω), [in Sm.: [[Isa.3.1|Isa.3:1]] * ;]
1. a setting firmly, supporting.
2. **fixedness, firmness, steadfastness**: [[2Pe.3.17|2Pe.3:17]]†
(AS)

G4764.def:
**στρῆνος**, -ους, τό
(cf. Lat. strenuus), [in LXX: [[2Ki.19.28|4Ki.19:28]] (שַׁאֲנָן)* ;]
**insolent luxury, wantonness**: [[Rev.18.3|Rev.18:3]] (a late word, first found in a Comic poet, B.C. 300, see Kennedy, _Sources_, 41, cf. στρηνιάω).†
(AS)

G4763.def:
**στρηνιάω**, ῶ
(στρῆνος, which see), [in Sm.: [[Isa.61.6|Isa.61:6]] (אָכַל) * ;]
a word which first appears in the middle comedy (Rutherford, _NPhr._, 475 f.), **to run riot, wax wanton**: [[Rev.18.7-9|Rev.18:7-9]] (cf. κατα-στρηνιάω).†
_SYN._: σπαταλάω (which see), τρυφάω (AS)
